meta.description: Private tours of Paris with Agathe: neighborhoods, designers, gourmet addresses, history and the Parisian way of life.

home.title: Discover Paris through the eyes of a Parisian.
home.lead: Paris is more than its famous monuments. It is a rhythm, a mood, a collection of little moments: a quiet street in Saint-Germain-des-Prés, the scent of fresh bread in a neighborhood bakery, a hidden garden behind an unassuming gate, a café terrace where Parisians linger over conversation, the view of the sunset from a century-old bridge.
home.body:
Forget the traditional tourist trails. For a few hours or a full day, let me take you to discover the Paris I love — the city’s true soul.

From the history of iconic landmarks to shops you won’t find in guidebooks, and from art galleries to the best local pastry shops, I invite you to experience Paris in a different way: with a sense of curiosity, a personal touch, and a lively spirit.
home.ways: Whether in a chauffeured car, on foot, by bike (in summer), or in a small open-top Jeep on sunny days, let’s plan your Parisian getaway together.
home.signature: Paris is my city. It could be a little bit yours, too.

about.title: Who am I?
about.body:
Born to Parisian parents, I grew up between Paris and various locations abroad, moving with my parents’ careers and my own studies. Naturally curious and passionate about travel, I have explored much of the world. From Africa to Polynesia, London to Los Angeles, and Milan to Madrid, I have been fortunate enough to discover different ways of life, cultures, and perspectives on the world.

Yet Paris has always remained my anchor — the place where I returned to my family and my roots. It has been my home base since childhood.

After a career in events and design, I wanted to bring together everything that drives me: meeting people, sharing knowledge, culture, the art of living, and, of course, my love for Paris.

I enjoy telling the story of a monument just as much as unearthing a unique boutique, chatting with a passionate artisan, picking out a great spot for a bite to eat, or taking you to a garden you never would have imagined finding there.
about.quote: My goal isn’t to show you all of Paris; it is to help you discover the city through my eyes and the places I love most.
about.pronounce_text:
Forget Agatha — I'm Agathe, with an e at the end!

Here's a little trick: say “I got” in a strong American accent, and you're already halfway there.

Easy, right? Now you can remember my name, pronounce it perfectly, and take all the credit!
about.languages_text: I welcome guests in French and English, both of which I speak fluently. I can also help you discover Paris in Spanish or Italian.

experiences.title: Paris, my way
experiences.subtitle: Experiences designed with you in mind

items.title: Paris by Neighborhood
items.text: Saint-Germain-des-Prés, Le Marais, the Latin Quarter, Île Saint-Louis, Montmartre, the favorite addresses of Emily in Paris or Amélie Poulain, the Da Vinci Code mystery… Each neighborhood has its own history, atmosphere, habits, style and little secrets. I help you capture their spirit — going beyond the facades.

items.title: Paris: Designers and Fine Spots
items.text: French designers, independent boutiques, art galleries, artisans, and unexpected places: let’s meet the people who make Paris so rich and unique today.

items.title: Gourmet Paris
items.text: An exquisite pastry shop, an exceptional cheese, a passionate wine merchant, a must-try specialty… I’ll take you to the shops I love, chosen for the quality of their products and the joy the owners take in sharing their expertise.

items.title: Paris: History and Culture
items.text: From major monuments to street architecture, from historical anecdotes to current exhibitions, let’s uncover the stories hidden behind what meets the eye. We can also step into galleries or explore the capital’s secret gardens.

items.title: Paris: The Parisian Way of Life
items.text: How do Parisians live? Where do they go out? How do they dress? What do their neighborhoods reveal about their tastes and lifestyles? How do they vote? With a little observation, a few anecdotes, and plenty of curiosity, Paris becomes a wonderful place of discovery.

experiences.intro:
Would you like to discover the must-see sights, browse the boutiques, dedicate a day to art and design, or seek out the best gourmet spots?

I offer itineraries I have developed and refined over time, or we can create a completely personalized tour together.

Whether you are a couple, a family, a group of friends or a small party (maximum 3 people per vehicle), each outing is tailored to your preferences, your pace and your interests.

To get around, there are several options depending on the season and the weather: on foot, by bike, in a small open-top Jeep when the weather is fine, or by chauffeured car when conditions call for it.

From two hours to a full day, anything is possible: we simply find the format that suits you best. A detailed quote is provided for every request.
experiences.prices_text:
The price depends on the length of the tour, the transport chosen (chauffeured car, on foot, by bike, open-top Jeep…), the size of your group, and how you book (through a travel agency, a concierge service, or directly with me). Tell me what you have in mind and I’ll send you a precise quote.

The longer the tour, the lower the hourly rate.
prices: From €250 per hour for 3 people by chauffeured car
From €150 per hour for 3 people on foot, starting from your hotel (within central Paris)
